test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was popularly known as ‘Gurudev’ for his expertise in binding together elements of Indian classical music and folk pieces to suit the western tunes entailed with precision along with his expertise in other art domains?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Rabindranath Tagore **

__
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was a mystic, artist and **Bengali polymath** (great poet, philosopher, music composer and a leader of Brahma Samaj).
 
• He took Indian culture and tradition to the whole world and became a **voice of Indian heritage**.
 
• He was the** first Non-European** to be **awarded the Nobel Prize in literature in 1913** with his book **Gitanjali: Song Offerings.**
 
• **Gitanjali (Song Offerings)**, **Gora (Fair-Faced) and Ghare-Baire (The Home and the World) **are his best-known works.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Abanindranath Tagore**

 
• The** principal artist **and creator of the **Indian Society of Oriental Art.**
 
• The **first major exponent **of **Swadeshi values in Indian art**.
 
• He founded the i**nfluential Bengal school of art,** which led to the **development of modern Indian painting.**

**Hemanta Mukherjee**

 
• **Indian music director** and** playback singer who primarily sang in Bengali and Hindi.**
 
• Also sang in Indian languages like **Marathi, Gujarati, Odia, Assamese, Tamil, Punjabi, Bhojpuri, Konkani, Sanskrit and Urdu.**
 
• Recipient of** two** **National Awards for Best Male Playback Singer** and was popularly known as the **"voice Of God".**

**Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay**

 
• Indian novelist, poet and journalist.
 
• He was the author of the **1882 Bengali language novel Anandamath(** one of the landmarks of modern Bengali and Indian literature).
 
• His famous novels were: **Kapalkundala (1866), Mrinalini (1869), Vishbriksha (1873), Chandrasekhar (1877), Rajani (1877), Rajsimha (1881), and Devi Chaudhurani (1884).**
